TYPE!
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR A ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
FOR THE PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS
3841-45 WEST DEVON AVENUE

Applicant seeks a Type | Map Amendment of the City of Chicago Zoning Map from the
current B1-1 District to that of an B2-2 District for the property commonly known as 3841-
45 West Devon Avenue. The site is improved with a one-story building containing ground
floor commercial space. Applicant seeks to increase the size of the building by adding
second and third floors. The construction will result in the addition of two residential units
being located on the second and third floors each, for a total of four residential dwelling
units. The existing 4,448 square feet of commercial space on the ground floor will remain.

The following is a list of the proposed bulk and density of the development:

Lot Area: 5,500 square feet

Density: 4 residential dwelling units

Lot Area Per Unit: 1,375 square feet

Off Street Parking: 4 spaces (existing)

Height: approximately 38 feet

Floor Area: approximately 9,160 square feet
Floor Area Ratio: approximately 1.67

Front (North) Setback: 0 feet (existing)
Rear (South) Setback: approximately 9.84 feet (existing)
East Side Setback: 0 feet (existing)
West Side Setback: 0 feet (existing)
